title: Yo-kai Watch
subtitle: The creatures behind an ordinary day
summary: Yo-kai Watch is Level-5's Nintendo 3DS role-playing game about a child who gains the ability to see creatures responsible for everyday mischief. A special watch reveals the invisible Yo-kai living around Springdale, while the talkative Whisper explains this hidden world. Befriending its inhabitants produces medals that allow them to be summoned in battle. The adventure gives an ordinary neighbourhood another population to discover. Streets, homes and shops become places where a small human problem may have a supernatural character hiding just behind it.
body: Yo-kai Watch is Level-5's Nintendo 3DS role-playing game about a child who gains the ability to see creatures responsible for everyday mischief. A special watch reveals the invisible Yo-kai living around Springdale, while the talkative Whisper explains this hidden world. Befriending its inhabitants produces medals that allow them to be summoned in battle. The adventure gives an ordinary neighbourhood another population to discover. Streets, homes and shops become places where a small human problem may have a supernatural character hiding just behind it.

A battle team contains six Yo-kai arranged around a wheel, with three active at a time. Rotating the wheel changes the group facing the enemy, making position and readiness part of the player's work while the creatures perform ordinary actions automatically. Touchscreen activities prepare special Soultimate moves, and other interventions help the team recover from trouble. The arrangement makes managing companions different from choosing every individual attack. A useful response can involve bringing a rested member forward or preparing the special action that the current situation needs.

Exploring Springdale introduces Yo-kai through local incidents and side quests, giving their personalities a role beyond the battle roster. Food can help persuade a creature to become a friend, connecting items bought around town with the collection of new medals. Familiar companions such as Jibanyan give the hidden population a recognisable face. The appeal lies in returning to ordinary places with a new reason to look closely. A school day or a family disagreement can lead to another discovery, gradually filling the neighbourhood with memorable supernatural residents.
